interface.name: jwm_remote_control_manager_v1
interface.description: A trusted local host must obtain explicit control consent, select a source on this connection, and authenticate its remote peer. Each creation request grants its named actions on a focused surface. This interface cannot change focus or authorize clipboard, compositor grabs, or global input.

request.name: create_lease_with_scroll
request.description: Like create_lease, but additionally grants single-notch vertical wheel actions. Binding version two alone does not grant scroll. The original create_lease never grants scroll.

request.name: create_lease_with_scroll_axes
request.description: Explicitly permits only the named axes: bit 0 vertical, bit 1 horizontal. Values 1, 2 and 3 are valid; zero and unknown bits are denied. Old creation requests retain their original permissions at every bind version.

request.name: create_resumable_lease
request.description: Only this creation request permits pause and resume. Axes 0 through 3 select no wheel, vertical, horizontal, or both. Binding v4 alone never adds permission. The original absolute 30 second lifetime and source/seat identity remain unchanged across pauses.

request.name: create_timed_resumable_lease
request.description: Like create_resumable_lease, but explicitly accepts remaining lifetime 1 through 300000 ms. No additional input types or quotas are granted. The caller must independently obtain both peers' duration consent and pass only the original budget remaining. Old requests always retain their 30 second lifetime, even at version 5.

request.name: create_gesture_lease
request.description: Explicitly permits using Shift, Control and left Alt with supported pointer actions, and in-surface left-button dragging. Axes 0 through 3 select the independently allowed wheel axes. The nonrenewable lifetime is 30 seconds. Old creation requests keep their original permissions.

request.name: create_window_gesture_lease

description.summary: gestures including clicks on a shared window's subsurfaces

request.description: Adds atomic clicks on same-client subsurfaces using the presented frame's exact input geometry. A drag start on a subsurface reserves a click, delivered only on release without intervening movement or layout change. Drags and scrolling use the root surface. This does not authorize xdg popups or compositor grabs. The one-shot 30-second lifetime and earlier creation requests are unchanged.

interface.name: jwm_remote_control_lease_v1
interface.description: Each capture source permits one bundle attempt, including failed admission. The host must compare the viewer and native XKB maps, then arm using the first genuinely ready image-copy frame after the viewer reports presenting it. One sequence orders keys and pointer actions. A new pointer action or drag starts from a fresh ready frame after prior input. The explicitly authorized drag may continue on the identical focused target and geometry until button release or revocation. Its raw button serials carry no compositor grab authority.

arg.name: kind
arg.summary: 0 motion, 1 atomic left click, 2 wheel up, 3 wheel down, 4 wheel left, 5 wheel right, 6 drag start with explicit v6 gesture grant

arg.name: reason
arg.summary: 1 denied, 2 source, 3 focus or seat, 4 local takeover, 5 timeout, 6 malformed sequence, 7 quota

request.name: pause
request.description: Consumes the next global sequence and current generation (initially 1). Only an armed explicitly resumable lease may pause. Paused is emitted only after native held-key cleanup succeeds; failure revokes permanently. No input is accepted while paused.

request.name: resume

description.summary: resume same authority with fresh proof

request.description: Consumes the next global sequence and generation plus one. Requires a genuinely ready frame newer than pause and all consumed proofs, at most one second old, the same unchanged native authority and clean input state. Does not reset lifetime, quota or authority. Legacy arm cannot resume a pause.

request.name: drag_motion

description.summary: move the original held left button within the source

request.description: Requires an active drag and valid current source, geometry and seat. Coordinates remain surface-local and bounded.

request.name: drag_release

description.summary: release the original held left button

request.description: Consumes the next sequence and sends a left-button release at the last position. Accepted follows delivery to the original receivers.
